content:
maria-support: customer reported 502/SSL_HANDSHAKE errors to their private VPC endpoint after uploading a new cert bundle, says it started ~09:10 UTC. cc @eng-oncall-bot
alex-eng: thanks — can you paste the output of `openssl s_client -connect customer-vpc.api.internal:443 -showcerts` and the uploaded PEM?
chao-support: got the customer's uploaded bundle (from support UI). Quick check: upload size 2.1KB. previous bundle size 3.4KB. looks suspicious.
sophia-sre: checked logs from edge LB — "TLS handshake failed: client did not present a valid chain" repeatedly between 09:11–09:15. Firewall/traceroute checks show no network drops, so likely cert chain problem.
maria-support: pasted customer-provided openssl snippet into thread:
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.customer.internal
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
verify return:1
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=api.customer.internal
   i:/CN=Customer Intermediate CA
---
SSL handshake has read 1763 bytes and written 513 bytes
---
Verify return code: 20 (unable to get local issuer certificate)
```
alex-eng: Verify code 20 usually means the intermediate is missing. Can you confirm what they uploaded?
chao-support: customer instructions show they created bundle with `cat server.crt root.crt > bundle.pem` — they accidentally skipped intermediate. Repro steps they used attached.
maria-support: reproduced quickly by uploading a 2.1KB bundle that contains server cert + root; HA proxy accepted upload but served incomplete chain. UI validation didn't catch missing intermediate.
sophia-sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) roll back to previous cert version (we still have active previous bundle), or 2) re-upload complete bundle (server + intermediate + root) via admin API so refresh is immediate. Which do we want?
alex-eng: do both — roll back traffic to previous cert for minimal risk, and request customer re-upload correct bundle. chao, can you coordinate rollback?
chao-support: rolling back now via admin API. Patch applied, routing toggled to previous bundle id=cb-2023-09-05. Waiting for propagation.
eng-oncall-bot: automated alert: cert-rollover job completed for customer-vpc.service (propagation ok) :white_check_mark: 1870712372
maria-support: asked customer to generate correct bundle with: `cat server.crt intermediate.crt root.crt > bundle.pem` and to include all PEM blocks in that order. Also asked them to run `openssl s_client -connect ... -showcerts` after upload and send output.
chao-support: customer confirmed they re-uploaded full bundle at 09:18 UTC and ran `openssl` — Verify return code: 0. They report traffic returned to normal.
sophia-sre: root cause: customer-side process omitted intermediate when assembling bundle; our upload UI accepted the file but lacked validation to detect missing chain. Action items: add server-side bundle validation (verify chain complete and issuer chain up to trusted root) + detect size regressions on re-uploads.
maria-support: filing a follow-up ticket for devex/docs to add clearer instructions and for eng to add validation. Also sending customer a short postmortem and recommended bundling steps. :thumbsup:
support-bot: created ticket SD-4812 for upload-validation and SD-4813 for docs update
alex-eng: thanks team — closing thread after tickets created. Please add any further customer comments to SD-4812.
